proposal: ER-04.08 governs (generator terminals); the connection agreement requirement is met with the plant's reactive capability less the GSU losses.
question: ER-04.08 requires 0.85 lagging / 0.95 leading at rated active power at the generator terminals; ALP-OWN-ELE-001 section 3 states the same at the connection point. At the connection point, at the winter GT output of 470 MW, the GT generator and GSU would need about 600 MVA instead of 560 MVA (GSU reactive losses). Please confirm that ER-04.08 governs.
response: ER-04.08 governs: 0.85 lagging / 0.95 leading at rated active power at the generator terminals. The TSO accepts the Grid Code compliance demonstration on that basis; ALP-OWN-ELE-001 will be corrected in its next revision.
subject: Reactive capability: generator terminals (ER-04.08) or connection point (ELE-001)
